hero_lead: Gentle help to clear your space — and your mind. One small step at a time.
intro_p1: Losing someone is hard. So is everything after. We walk beside you through the work of letting go and clearing out. Your space — and your mind — can breathe again.
intro_p2: Sometimes it's not a loss. It's just everyday clutter. What starts as a small pile of clothes to fold can turn into dread. It can feel like too much. But it can also become something good.
intro_p3: A little organizing can lead to a lot more breathing room.
help_text: Tell us a little about your space and we'll take it from there — it only takes a minute.
ba_sub: Real spaces we've helped clear. No judgment, ever — just a fresh start.
how_sub: We move at your pace. You're always in charge.

how_cards.title: Reach out
how_cards.text: Tell us what you're facing. A little or a lot — it's all okay.

how_cards.title: Make a plan
how_cards.text: We plan it together. No rush. No judgment. Your goals lead the way.

how_cards.title: Clear it together
how_cards.text: We work side by side to sort, let go, and organize what stays.

how_cards.title: Breathe again
how_cards.text: Enjoy your space — and the calm that comes with it.
